_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with F&G 48 and no flow/funding breaker; base-rate 17% move odds make HOLD the skilled default while score can drift one rung into Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative only restates current Anxiety with no forward view
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC continues chopping, composite stays 47-54, funding flat, ETF flows remain dead
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF-flow rebound plus F&G >55 (up into Disbelief) or flush with F&G <39 and negative funding (down into deeper Anxiety/Panic)
